positions.commentary: The speaker argues that despite the stock being expensive, it must come down due to growth priced in.

thesis: This episode argues that Costco (COST) must see its stock price decline because the current valuation is expensive and already reflects significant growth.

claims.claim: The speaker argues that despite the stock being expensive, it must come down due to growth priced in.
claims.quote: Well, you know, the one good thing about having missed the stock and it being so expensive is that I'm kind of sure it'll come, because there's so much growth priced into the stock that it has to come.

numbers.what: frequency of dinners at Charlie Munger's place
numbers.value: four or five times a year
numbers.quote: probably I would have dinner four or five times a year.

numbers.what: number of Costco stores visited by the couple in the book
numbers.quote: They visited, I think, hundreds of Costco stores.

numbers.what: minimum time spent with Charlie Munger without Costco
numbers.quote: Every time I had meet Charlie, at least 30 minutes without Costco, somehow the other the conversation was always going to Costco.
